gold.user: A developer wants to retrieve the details of a specific IP Access Control List mapping for a SIP domain using the Account SID and Domain SID.
gold.ideal: The API should return the details of the specified IP Access Control List mapping, including its SID, friendly name, and associated IP addresses.

gold.user: An administrator needs to remove an existing IP Access Control List mapping from a SIP domain to ensure that certain IP addresses are no longer allowed access.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully delete the specified IP Access Control List mapping and return a confirmation message indicating the deletion was successful.

gold.user: A system integrator is adding a new IP Access Control List mapping to a SIP domain to allow a specific IP address to access the service.
gold.ideal: The API should create a new IP Access Control List mapping and return the details of the newly created mapping, including its SID and friendly name.

gold.user: A network administrator wants to view all existing IP Access Control List mappings for a specific SIP domain to manage access control effectively.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all IP Access Control List mappings associated with the specified SIP domain, including their SIDs and friendly names.
